summary: Backend regression + P2 hardening validation after monolith split. Ran 34 pytest cases against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 34 passed (27 prior regression + 7 new): atomic counter (parallel ritiri & consegne yield fully distinct numero), PATCH consegne stato=consegnata auto-sets data_consegna_effettiva=today, dashboard KPI exposes consegne_consegnate/consegne_puntuali/puntualita_pct with correct math, past-prevista consegna is NOT puntuale, future-prevista IS puntuale, modular router structure loadable and server.py is thin (<=80 LOC).

minor.issue: data_consegna_effettiva is derived from server UTC date (now_utc().date().isoformat()); for late-evening CET/UTC boundary deliveries the on-time comparison could mis-classify by 1 day. Minor; acceptable trade-off.
puntualita compares ISO date strings lexicographically - correct as long as both are stored 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Add Pydantic date validation on PATCH body.stato/data_prevista to harden.
Body is typed Dict[str, Any] (no Pydantic). Allows arbitrary field writes; consider a PatchConsegnaIn schema.
Unused 'cliente' role branch in GET /api/fatture still present (carried over from iter 1).

action_items: (Optional) Add Pydantic PatchConsegnaIn/PatchLavorazioneIn/PatchNonConformitaIn schemas instead of raw Dict[str, Any].
(Optional) Remove dead 'cliente' role branch in GET /api/fatture or formally document the role.
(Optional) Store created_at / data_prevista as datetime objects in Mongo to avoid lex-string comparisons and enable range queries.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now a clean 42-line entry point wiring 6 routers under /api - excellent refactor.
core.next_seq uses findOneAndUpdate + $inc + upsert + ReturnDocument.AFTER: textbook-correct atomic counter, verified under 8-way concurrent POST with zero duplicates.
seed.ensure_counters() seeds counters to count_documents() only when the doc is absent - correctly idempotent; will not reset after restart.
operations.update_consegna uses body.setdefault('data_consegna_effettiva', ...) so explicit dates from client are preserved while default falls back to today - good.
dashboard.dashboard_kpi correctly guards division-by-zero with 100.0 default and uses string-date <= comparison (works for ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD').
require_roles still implicitly allows admin even if not listed - documented behavior, verified.
All routers consistently exclude _id and password_hash.
MINOR: PATCH endpoints (consegne, lavorazioni, non-conformita) accept raw Dict[str, Any] - should be typed Pydantic models for consistency with POST endpoints.
MINOR: core.JWT_SECRET still has a fallback default value - acceptable for dev but should fail-fast if env missing in prod.
